name: 男の子（赤パーカー・持ち歩き）
author: kaede

source.prompt: Outfit swap of the bent-elbow carry variant (v2 of this sheet — regenerated after the carry respec of 2026-08-09: bent near arm, palm up, both arms still): avatar.boy-basic-carry restyled into the red-hoodie look via google/nano-banana-2 sheet edit (~$0.10, first try; silhouette IoU vs the carry sheet 0.945-0.955). Same keep-everything edit prompt as avatar.boy-basic-red plus clauses naming the bent near arm and wide strides (the earlier flat-arm red carry needed one retry after an edit softened the strides — the IoU gate catches that failure class). The neck anchors transfer from avatar.boy-basic-carry (heads identical by construction; the hood breaks the neck-pinch heuristic). The hand anchors were re-measured on THIS sheet (an outfit edit moves where the hand is drawn — the spike's per-sheet measurement rule) via skin-blob detection of the palm-up hand + visual confirmation. handLayer: true cuts this sheet's own bare mitten (long sleeves cover the forearm, so the overlay is the hand only), rendered on top of held items.
